result.title: Universal Online Convex Optimization With Delayed Feedback
result.summary: We study universal online convex optimization with delayed feedback. We develop a single algorithm that simultaneously adapts to general convex, strongly convex, and exp-concave losses without prior knowledge of the curvature class or parameters. Our regret bounds match the best known dependence on the time horizon $T$ and delays up to doubly logarithmic factors: roughly $\sqrt{T + d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ for convex losses and $σ_{\max}\log T$ rates with curved losses, where $d_{\mathrm{tot}}$ is the total cumulative delay and $σ_{\max}$ is the maximum number of simultaneously missing observations. Our main technical contribution is a delayed meta-learner with a second-order excess-loss guarantee, which enables curvature-adaptive aggregation of delayed base learners. In addition, our new exp-concave base learner yields a sharper regret bound which improves the state-of-the-art delay dependence by replacing the maximum delay with the potentially much smaller $σ_{\max}$, while retaining the complementary $\sqrt{d_{\mathrm{tot}}}$ dependence.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究带延迟反馈的通用在线凸优化，提出单一算法在未知曲率类别的情况下同时适应凸、强凸与 exp-concave 损失，并借助具二阶超额损失保证的延迟元学习器聚合延迟基学习器，给出接近最优的遗憾界。
AI.relevance_reason: 「最大同时缺失观测数」与元学习器聚合的界，可能为 LVR 中证据分批到达、延迟监督下的信用分配与多 latent 假设聚合提供形式化线索，可供核查。
